nodes.description: Mapping of reflection balances for every address; mutated during transfers and fee reflection.
Nested mapping of ERC20 allowances owner => spender => amount.
Mapping flagging addresses excluded from fee/cooldown logic.
Blacklist mapping checked at the start of _transfer.
Total reflection supply, reduced by fees in _reflectFee.
Tax fee percentage applied to transfers.
Team fee percentage applied to transfers.
Payable marketing/fee wallet that receives ETH and authorizes manual swap/send.
Stored Uniswap V2 router instance used for swaps and liquidity.
Token/WETH pair address created in openTrading.
Guard flag preventing openTrading from being executed twice.
Reentrancy guard state toggled by the lockTheSwap modifier.
Flag enabling automatic contract-token to ETH swaps during transfers.
Flag enabling the max transaction amount cooldown check.
Maximum amount accepted in a single transfer while cooldown is enabled.
Constant total token supply and reference for rate calculations.
Caller-controlled address returned by _msgSender, used for ownership checks and transfer initiator.
Miner-controllable timestamp passed as swap/liquidity deadline.
External call to the Uniswap router that swaps contract tokens for ETH and can transfer control externally.
Raw ETH transfers to three owner-configured fee wallets; failure reverts the whole flow.
Ether-sending external call that adds liquidity in openTrading using the contract balance.
Initializes fee wallets, reflection supply, fee exclusions and emits the initial Transfer.
Public ERC20 transfer that forwards _msgSender, recipient and amount to _transfer.
Public ERC20 transferFrom that transfers and decreases the allowance via SafeMath.sub.
Core transfer routine: bot check, fee selection, cooldown/max amount check and conditional auto-swap + ETH payout.
Approves the router and swaps contract-held tokens for ETH; guarded by lockTheSwap and uses block.timestamp as deadline.
Splits the contract ETH balance into three equal transfers to the fee wallets.
Owner-only bootstrap: sets router/pair, approves, adds liquidity with ETH, enables swapping and sets limits.
Fee-wallet-only function that manually swaps the entire contract token balance for ETH.
Fee-wallet-only function that manually forwards the contract ETH balance to fee wallets.
Owner-only toggle for the cooldown flag.
Owner-only function restoring _maxTxAmount to the full total supply.
Owner-only function that sets the owner to the zero address.
Internal allowance setter that validates both addresses and emits Approval.
Applies reflection math: debits sender, credits recipient, takes team tokens and reflects fees.
Sender address parameter of _transfer, compared against bots and the pair.
Recipient address parameter of _transfer, checked against fee exclusions.
Token amount parameter of _transfer, validated and compared to _maxTxAmount.
Cached balanceOf(address(this)) used to decide the automatic swap size.
Cached contract ETH balance checked against the 0.3 ETH payout threshold.
Token amount passed into swapTokensForEth and approved to the router.
Transfer amount consumed by _transferStandard when computing reflection values.

edges.reason: onlyOwner modifier compares _owner with _msgSender before allowing the cooldown toggle.
liftMaxTx is protected by onlyOwner which reads the caller-controlled _msgSender.
renounceOwnership relies on the onlyOwner check of the caller address.
manualswap requires _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1 before swapping contract tokens.
manualsend requires _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1 before draining ETH.
openTrading is owner-only and performs the privileged router/liquidity setup.
transfer forwards the caller address as the sender into _transfer.
transferFrom uses the caller as spender for the allowance deduction.
Caller-derived sender reaches the core _transfer routine through transfer/transferFrom.
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline, making the swap outcome timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline during trading bootstrap.
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom delegates to the internal _transfer routine before updating the allowance.
_transfer conditionally triggers swapTokensForEth mid-execution before completing state updates, enabling reentrant external interaction.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call that can re-enter the contract.
_transfer sends accumulated ETH to fee wallets while still mid-transfer, opening reentrant value flow.
sendETHToFee performs raw ETH transfers that can invoke the recipients and re-enter.
_transfer finishes by calling _transferStandard to apply the balances.
manualswap invokes the same external-swap routine, again exposing reentrancy.
manualsend forwards the contract balance to fee wallets via external transfers.
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH with the contract ETH balance, an external value call.
openTrading assigns the Uniswap V2 router address to storage.
openTrading stores the newly created pair address.
swapTokensForEth sets and clears the inSwap guard, indicating the protected external call region.
_transfer gates the automatic swap on the swapEnabled flag.
_transfer gates the max amount check on the cooldownEnabled flag.
_transfer reads _maxTxAmount when enforcing the cooldown limit.
_transfer reads the bots blacklist mapping for the sender.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee for the recipient and the pair path.
setCooldownEnabled writes the cooldownEnabled state variable.
liftMaxTx overwrites _maxTxAmount with the full supply.
openTrading sets tradingOpen to true at the end of the bootstrap.
_transferStandard debits and credits the _rOwned reflection balances.
transferFrom reads and decreases the _allowances mapping.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping for owner and spender.
swapTokensForEth calls _approve to grant the router an allowance.
swapTokensForEth reads the stored router instance to perform the swap.
The external router swap operates on the uniswapV2Router target address.
The ETH transfers send value to the owner-configured payable fee wallets.
swapTokensForEth consumes its tokenAmount parameter for approval and the swap.
sendETHToFee splits its amount parameter into three wallet transfers.
_transferStandard consumes tAmount when deriving reflection values.
_transfer reads its from parameter for bot, pair and exclusion checks.
_transfer reads its to parameter for the router and exclusion checks.
_transfer reads its amount parameter for the zero and max amount checks.
_transfer computes contractTokenBalance to size the automatic swap.
_transfer computes contractETHBalance to decide whether to forward ETH to fees.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only exists inside _transfer, so it should be normalized into the _transfer function node.
The to parameter is local to _transfer and carries no standalone semantic value.
The amount parameter is used only within _transfer and should collapse into that function.
This temporary balance cache is computed and consumed solely inside _transfer.
This temporary ETH balance cache exists only during the _transfer execution.
The tokenAmount parameter is exclusive to swapTokensForEth and should merge into it.
This local amount variable is only meaningful inside _transferStandard.
